title_ar: الشيخ الددو ضيف دائم على قناة فور شباب طيلة أيام شهر رمضان في برنامج مفاهيم ج3
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew a Standing Guest on the 4Shbab Channel throughout Ramadan on the Programme "Concepts", Part 3
body_ar:
تستضيف قناة فور شباب فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء في برنامج مفاهيم ( الجزء الثالث)، بوصفه ضيفا دائما للبرنامج، وذلك طيلة أيام شهر رمضان الكريم ويُحاور الشيخ في هذه الحلقات الدكتور عادل باناعمه.

يبث هذا البرنامج كل يوم من أيام الشهر المبارك في الساعة الخامسة والنصف مساء بتوقيت مكة المكرمة، 1:30 زوالا بالتوقيت العالمي، ويعاد بثه السادسة والنصف مساء بتوقيت مكة المكرمة، 3:30 صباحا بالتوقيت العالمي.

ويهتم برنامج مفاهيم (الجزء الثالث)، بالمصطلحات والمفاهيم المتداولة في الوسط الشبابي بشكل عام، سواء كانت مفاهيم شرعية أو تربوية أو دعوية أو اجتماعية.

حيث يسلط الضوء عليها من خلال تجلية معناها الصحيح وحدود تطبيقاتها المقبولة، والإشارة إلى ما يحصل فيها من خطأ على المستوى المعرفي أو المستوى التطبيقي، وذلك انطلاقا من الموازين الشرعية ومراعاة فقه الفتوى والواقع في المنهج الوسطي المعتدل.

ونشير كذلك إلى أن هناك برامج أخرى تبث في القنوات الأخرى للشيخ خلال الشهر الكريم منها قناة دليل وقناة الرسالة، والتلفزة الوطنية لموريتانيا، وسيعلن عن مواعيدها في وقت لاحق قبل بثها، لذلك ننوه بأهميتها وندعو الجمهور الكريم إلى اغتنام هذه الفرصة الرمضانية الثمينة.

وسيعمل القائمون على الموقع – إنشاء الله- على مواكبة حلقات هذا البرنامج وبثها مباشرة على الموقع ورفعها في القسم الخاص بها في جديد الموقع مع تلخيص لأهم أفكارها وتبسيط معانيها ليحصل النفع وتعم الفائدة.

لمتابعة ما تقدم من حلقات البرنامج اضغط هنا:
body_en:
The 4Shbab channel is hosting His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars, on the programme "Concepts" (part three), as a standing guest of the programme, throughout the days of the noble month of Ramadan. In these episodes the Sheikh is in conversation with Dr ʿAdil Banaʿmah.

This programme is broadcast every day of the blessed month at half past five in the evening, Mecca time — 1:30 in the afternoon, universal time — and is repeated at half past six in the evening, Mecca time — 3:30 in the morning, universal time.

The programme "Concepts" (part three) is concerned with the terms and concepts current among young people generally, whether they are concepts of the Sharia, or educational, or daʿwah-related, or social ones.

It throws light on them by bringing out their correct meaning and the limits of their acceptable applications, and by pointing to the error that occurs in them at the level of understanding or at the level of application, proceeding in this from the criteria of the Sharia and from regard for the jurisprudence of issuing legal opinions and for circumstances, within the moderate, middle-way approach.

We note too that there are other programmes with the Sheikh broadcast on other channels during the noble month, among them the Dalil channel, the al-Risalah channel, and Mauritanian national television. Their times will be announced at a later date before they are broadcast, and we accordingly draw attention to their importance and invite the honoured public to take advantage of this precious Ramadan opportunity.

Those running the site will work, God willing, to keep pace with the episodes of this programme, to broadcast them live on the site, and to post them in the section set aside for them among the site's new material, together with a summary of their most important ideas and a simplification of their meanings, so that benefit may be had and may become general.

options: reproduce the times exactly as given and flag the arithmetic
flags.note: The conversions in the source do not work. Mecca is UTC+3, so 17:30 Mecca is 14:30 UTC, not 13:30; and 18:30 Mecca is 15:30 UTC, not 3:30 in the morning. Both figures are reproduced exactly as the source gives them and neither has been corrected, per style guide section 11. The record is in any case a schedule for Ramadan 1432 and is of no present use except as a record of what was announced.

flags.arabic: قناة فور شباب / الدكتور عادل باناعمه
flags.context: the channel and the Sheikh's interlocutor
flags.note: فور شباب is the satellite channel that trades in Latin script as 4Shbab, and its own spelling is used rather than a transliteration. The interlocutor's name is a Saudi one; باناعمه is most often written Bana'mah or Ba Na'mah in English and the segmentation is not certain from the Arabic alone. Flagged rather than fixed.

flags.arabic: مراعاة فقه الفتوى والواقع في المنهج الوسطي المعتدل
options: the jurisprudence of issuing legal opinions and regard for circumstances
the fiqh of fatwa and of reality
the practice of issuing opinions with due regard to context
flags.note: فقه الفتوى والواقع is a modern formula, not a classical category, and it is not in the glossary. It recurs in this span (see also record 761) and needs one fixed rendering decided centrally.

translator_notes: This is a programme announcement written by the site, not a text by the Sheikh, and contains no ruling of any kind. The five-rulings mapping of style guide section 3 is not engaged anywhere in it.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the announcement was written; the content places it at the start of Ramadan 1432, which began in early August 2011.

The closing line 'to follow the episodes of the programme already broadcast, click here' is the site's navigation furniture; preserved in body_ar, recorded in source_download_link, omitted from body_en.
The record is time-bound announcement copy. Displaying it in English fifteen years on without a date banner would present a past broadcast schedule as current.
